description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.
